additional_info.subject: Recurrent Fault on DC Charger - EVSE 170001151
additional_info.body:
Hello,
We are experiencing a recurring issue with charger  170001151:
Whenever a charging session is active on DC 2, the DC 1 shows the following error message:
“001: Other type of error. More information in Vendor Error Code - evse is not ready.”
The fault clears automatically once the DC 2 charging session ends.
Could you please check whether this behavior is expected due to shared power management, or if it indicates a known issue that requires a firmware update or configuration change?
A screenshot from the system is attached.
Thank you,
​
​
​
​
Ziv Vinitzer
Head of DC Charging

additional_info.subject: Re:‏ Recurrent Fault on DC Charger - EVSE 170001151
additional_info.body:
Hello,
We would like to report a recurring issue on charging station ID 170001151.
In several incidents, we observed that while charging is active on one CCS connector, the second connector unexpectedly enters a Faulted state, without any user interaction or command from our side.
The issue occurs during an active charging session on the parallel outlet.
Please note that in the past, as part of troubleshooting a similar issue, two DC contactors were replaced on this station. After the replacement, the issue appeared to be resolved; however, the problem has now reoccurred.
Attached are system logs screenshots showing the sequence of status changes and the error occurrence, including messages such as “Other type of error” / “EVSE is not ready”.
We would appreciate your support in investigating this issue, including:
Detailed log analysis from the charger
Confirmation whether this is a known issue
Recommendations for further checks or identification of a component that may be causing this recurring fault
Looking forward to your guidance on the next steps.
Thank you in advance for your support,
Ziv
